n, m, mo = map(int, input().split())

maxn = 505

# Initialize combination matrix C
C = [[0] * (maxn) for _ in range(maxn)]
C[0][0] = 1
for i in range(1, n + 2):
    C[i][0] = 1
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        C[i][j] = (C[i - 1][j] + C[i - 1][j - 1]) % mo

# Initialize f, g arrays
f = [0] * (n + 1)
g = [0] * (n + 1)

f[0] = 1
g[0] = 0
f[1] = 2
g[1] = 0

for i in range(2, n + 1):
    f[i] = (f[i] + f[i - 1] * (i + 1) * 2) % mo
    g[i] = (g[i] + f[i - 1] * i % mo * (i - 1)) % mo
    g[i] = (g[i] + g[i - 1] * (i + 1) * 2) % mo
    for j in range(1, i):
        k = i - j - 1
        if k >= 0:
            f[i] = (f[i] + f[j] * f[k] % mo * (j + k + 2) % mo * C[j + k][k]) % mo
            g[i] = (g[i] + (g[j] * f[k] + g[k] * f[j]) % mo * (j + k + 2) % mo * C[j + k][k]) % mo
            temp = ((j + 1) * j // 2 + (k + 1) * k // 2) % mo
            g[i] = (g[i] + f[j] * f[k] % mo * C[j + k][k] % mo * temp) % mo

# Initialize f0, g0 arrays
f0 = [[0] * (m + 1) for _ in range(m + 1)]
g0 = [[0] * (m + 1) for _ in range(m + 1)]

f0[0][0] = 1
g0[0][0] = 0

for i in range(m + 1):
    for j in range(m + 1):
        if f0[i][j]:
            for k in range(1, m - j + 1):
                f0[i + 1][j + k] = (f0[i + 1][j + k] + f0[i][j] * f[k] % mo * C[j + k][k]) % mo
                g0[i + 1][j + k] = (g0[i + 1][j + k] + (g0[i][j] * f[k] + f0[i][j] * g[k]) % mo * C[j + k][k]) % mo

ans = 0
for i in range(1, m + 1):
    if n + 1 - m - i >= 0:
        ans = (ans + g0[i][m] * (C[n + 1 - m - i + i][i + 1])) % mo

print(ans)
